title: Never remove the old Claude skill path for a Codex target, in any skill-source mode (ODOC-556 R1)
description: Follow-up to QCLI-543 (PR #698), ruled by opum-doc, ODOC-556 R1 (verbatim): "A. Never deleted overrides QCLI-309 for the old skill path. For a Codex target, in every skill-source mode (repo, plugin, none), quest no longer removes .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md, even when the bytes match exactly and even under --force. It reports the file as drift and names the path, so the owner can delete it. Landed before the paired lore + quest release cut." Today, under skill_source plugin or none, the QCLI-309 orphan path (src/cli/main.ts agents handler, agent-instructions.ts updateQuestSkillFile) still removes a byte-exact generated .claude skill with --force for a codex target. #698 scoped its CHANGELOG line to that and said a ruling was pending.

acceptanceCriteria.text: For a codex target under skill_source plugin and none, quest agents --update-instructions --force leaves a byte-exact generated .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md byte-identical
For a codex target under plugin and none, quest agents --check exits 6 and its drift message names .claude/skills/quest/SKILL.md
A claude target under plugin and none still removes its own byte-exact orphan with --force (QCLI-309 unchanged for it)
The CHANGELOG line scoped in #698 states the new rule and no longer says a ruling is pending

implementationNotes: Implemented 2026-10-31 on fix/QCLI-545-codex-never-remove-claude-skill. The agents handler now checks/updates only the target's own skill path (a codex target never touches .claude as an orphan, in any skill-source mode); checkLeftoverClaudeSkill now runs in every mode, with a plugin/none message that names the path and says --force included. Help for --force and the CHANGELOG line updated; "ruling pending" removed. Tests: three new in test/qcli543-codex-skill-path.test.ts (plugin, none: byte-exact generated .claude skill survives --force byte-identical and --check exits 6 naming the path; claude target none: its own byte-exact orphan is still removed). The QCLI-236 hand-edited test in bootstrap-process.test.ts now passes --target claude, since for a codex target the .claude file is no longer an orphan. Mutation M5, prediction written to a file BEFORE the run: restoring the old removal for a codex target under plugin/none goes red on exactly the two plugin/none tests (16 pass, 2 fail); unmutated 18 pass. bun run test: only the QCLI-411 by-design failure remained after the QCLI-236 test fix (the one other failure was that test).

Review of #699 (Opus, d1922ec8): REQUEST CHANGES, one blocking item, fixed. Blocking 1: under plugin/none a CLAUDE.md or GEMINI.md Quest block silenced the leftover; the in-use exemption is now repo mode only (claudePathInUse && generatesSkill). Two new tests (plugin, none, CLAUDE.md block present, --check --target codex exits 6 with the exact message). Mutation M6, prediction in a file BEFORE the run: reverting the exemption goes red on exactly those two (18 pass, 2 fail); unmutated 20 pass. Also N1 (plugin/none tests assert the exact message), N3 (command-help says "the target's own skill file"), N5 (CHANGELOG re-wrapped, in-use sentence says repo mode only). N2 filed as QCLI-546, not fixed here. bun run test: only QCLI-411 by design.

Leader confirmed blocking 1 resolved at 815ae40b (read by ref: exemption is claudePathInUse && generatesSkill; new tests; M6 red as predicted). Opum round 1 was REQUEST CHANGES at d1922ec8. Cleared to land.
